newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium leading indicator fell in August - BNB.
newsitem.headline: Belgium leading indicator fell in August - BNB.

text.p: The Belgian National Bank (BNB) released the following indices based on its monthly survey of three key economic sectors -

NOTE - The leading index is based on central bank surveys of manufacturing, construction and retailing and calculated on the basis of the difference between positive and negative answers to the bank's questions.
It is slightly positive at the top of an economic cycle, while it is strongly negative at the depth of a recession.
